title: How many male clients in 'Hl.m. Praha' district?
question: How many male clients in 'Hl.m. Praha' district?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id)
FROM client_district AS T1
WHERE T1.gender = 'M'
  AND T1.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client_district
    WHERE A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
    LIMIT 1
  )
